claims.text: Andaz Napa is a boutique hotel in downtown Napa.

findings.quote: Be inspired by the charm of Napa Wine Country from our boutique downtown hotel.

claims.text: Oxbow Public Market and the Napa Valley Wine Train are both within walking distance of the hotel.

findings.quote: Experience essential Napa, including Oxbow Public Market and the Napa Valley Wine Train, which are both located within walking distance of our hotel.

claims.text: Rooms are rustic-chic, with hardwood floors and deep soaking tubs.

findings.quote: Retreat to the rustic-chic boutique hotel rooms of Andaz Napa, featuring hardwood floors and deep soaking tubs.

claims.text: Several rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and marble bathrooms with rain showers.

findings.quote: Enjoy a naturally lit space with floor-to-ceiling windows to admire Napa Valley views and a marble bathroom with a rain shower.
Enjoy a naturally lit space with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Napa Valley.
stay refreshed in the luxurious marble bathroom with a rain shower.

claims.text: The Andaz Tower Suite has 12-foot ceilings, a separate bedroom and an oversized soaking tub for two.

findings.quote: Enjoy your stay in this suite with soaring 12-foot ceilings, hardwood floors and a separate bedroom with a king bed. Admire panoramic views of downtown Napa from the floor-to-ceiling windows or relax in the oversized soaking tub for two.

claims.text: The Andaz Vintner Suite has a separate bedroom, a soaking tub for two, a dual-sided glass fireplace, a dining area and a furnished terrace.

findings.quote: Luxuriate in this Napa suite featuring a separate bedroom with a king bed, a soaking tub for two and a dual-sided glass fireplace. Gather at the table in the dining area, the sofas in the living room or on the furnished terrace.

claims.text: Rooms have Malin + Goetz bath toiletries.

findings.quote: Malin + Goetz Bath Toiletries

claims.text: The hotel offers exclusive hotel events and a tasting room for exploring Napa's arts, wine and culinary culture.

findings.quote: Explore the arts, wine and culinary culture through exclusive hotel events, a tasting room and world-class dining.

claims.text: Mercantile Social serves farm-fresh seasonal food made with local Napa ingredients.

findings.quote: Mercantile Social offers farm-fresh seasonal foods with local Napa ingredients, from salads and smoothies to grass-fed beef burgers.

claims.text: Andaz Farmers Table serves a farm-to-table breakfast around a communal dining table, with a Barista Bar.

findings.quote: Start your morning with a farm-to-table breakfast served in a rustic Napa restaurant setting. Gather around the communal dining table for handcrafted breakfast foods
pick up an invigorating coffee beverage from the Barista Bar.

claims.text: The hotel is pet friendly and provides a doggy bed, two bowls and treats for dogs.

findings.quote: We welcome your traveling canine companions to our pet-friendly hotel in Downtown Napa.
we will gladly provide a doggy bed, two bowls, and treats for your pup(s).

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the rooms as loft-like, with hardwood floors and contemporary touches, and the location as downtown and walkable.

findings.quote: Rooms are loft-like with hardwood floors and other beloved contemporary touches.
imagine you’ve come home to Napa, downtown and walkable

claims.text: Guests can choose a loft accommodation with a sleek fireplace or a suite with a furnished terrace overlooking downtown Napa.

findings.quote: Choose a loft accommodation with a sleek fireplace or upgrade to a suite with a furnished terrace overlooking the heart of downtown Napa.

claims.text: The Andaz Harvest Suite has a soaking tub for two and a retractable glass wall that opens to a furnished balcony.

findings.quote: Indulge in this suite featuring a king bed with a soaking tub for two. Lounge in the spacious separate living area and a retractable glass wall that opens to a furnished balcony.

claims.text: Mercantile Terrace is a second-floor outdoor restaurant with fire pits and cabanas, where mixologists craft cocktails with ingredients native to Napa Valley and Northern California.

findings.quote: Unwind with outdoor dining and drinks at our signature downtown Napa restaurant, Mercantile Terrace, located on the 2nd floor. Get cozy around fire pits or in a comfortable cabana
Expert mixologists craft refreshing beverages and cocktails with ingredients native to Napa Valley and Northern California.

claims.text: Oxbow Public Market and the Napa Valley Wine Train are both within walking distance of the hotel.

findings.quote: Experience essential Napa, including Oxbow Public Market and the Napa Valley Wine Train, which are both located within walking distance of our hotel.

claims.text: This is a downtown hotel; San Francisco International Airport is about 60 miles away.

findings.quote: Be inspired by the charm of Napa Wine Country from our boutique downtown hotel.
San Francisco International Airport (SFO)60 miles

claims.text: Self-parking is in the Clay Street Garage, directly behind the hotel.

findings.quote: Guests can park vehicles at the Clay Street Garage, located directly behind the hotel.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes limited on-site recreational facilities compared with resort-style properties.
